summary: For his contributions “to bringing cultures closer together and enriching the dialogue between France and Thailand,” Thai artist and filmmaker Apichatpong Weerasethakul was made a Knight of the National Order of the Legion of Honor in a ceremony at the French Residence in Bangkok on June 10. summary: When one reassesses the architectural designs of the technologically obsessed, postmodernist Archigram Collective (1961–74), they encounter a brand of space-age Futurism that feels as cutting-edge and charmingly obsolete as a pulpy sci-fi novel. summary: Self-taught photographer Duane Michals, known for unconventional and deeply personal narrative image sequences incorporating handwritten text, died in Manhattan on June 9 of pneumonia.
